worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.5: The one who stands before you is know as The Scourge, he is evil incarnate, in this world and countless others.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.6: I am surprised to see you here... yet, it can't just be a coincidence.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.7: I believe you are a kindhearted soul, sent here to rescue this tiny world.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.8: But I must warn you, every world, every dimension, have been haunted by a one and only being : him.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.9: He is capable of taking different forms, of adapting and corrupting everything he touches, world after the other.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.10: You must be a lone survivor of his cruelty... as all traces of humanity has disappeared from this world.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.11: [weakly] Lies. Ignore this voice, she is manipulating you.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.12: Leave, now. Come back when armed, when you have fought the first manifestations of his hatred.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter0_set.13: Come back with an iron sword. I'll explain your mission in due time, if you so choose to help us.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter_1_ask.t: Are you ready for your first sealing ?
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.1: You're back... I do hope, it's not to do anything stupid.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.2: You know, I never intended to do any harm.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.3: I just tried to save many worlds in the best way I know. If you listen to me, you'll realise that-
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.4: You're here, and you've succeeded. Good.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.5: In this world, the sword we create are all enchanted with an ancient magic.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.6: Thanks to these, you'll be able to seal the Scourge. He his already partially sealed, but slowly that seal is weakening.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_set.7: The only way to save this world, is to seal the original version of the Scourge, the most powerful one.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_yes_se: Great, the seal is holding one... well for now at least.
Your next mission will be to craft a diamond sword.
You'll need different materials: gold, emerald and amethyst.
For now, focus on the world you reside in : the Overworld.
You'll visit other dimensions once you have better equipment.
And if you desire... maybe you could rebuild the lost civilisation.
Build a village, and when it is ready, I will breath new life into it.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter1_no_set: I see. Come back when ready.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_set.1: You're here. And you've managed to banish his followers, I know it wasn't easy, but-
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_set.2: Useless, it's all useless. These seals, there just ridiculous toys.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_set.3: She only seeks to gain an advantage over me, to steal my powers. I have never done anything wrong.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_set.4: I only want to live and I'm just defending myself, just like the ones she calls my followers.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_set.5: The only ones who truly kill is her... and who, her devoted puppet.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter_2_ask.t: Are you ready for the sealing ?
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_yes_se: Useless, everything you're doing is useless.
His hold on the different worlds is weakening.
It is due time to explore what lies beyond the Overworld.
Two places of interest : the Nether, realm of flames, and the Deepwaters, endless submarine caves.
In those two dimensions you will find foes to defeat and precious resources to gather.
It is your new mission. However do not forget the Overworld, it is still infested with wicked souls
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter2_no_set: Take the time to think it over.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.1: You have killed my Leviathan, my pet. And you've also stolen its offspring.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.2: It's pure evil. You're so cruel. When will this stop ?
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.3: I swear, you'll pay for this. If you so dare to stop me, at least know that it is simply impossible.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.4: From now on, I will send my most powerful followers. My Seven Deadly Sins.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.5: They will make you suffer until the end of you're miserable life. Enjoy the rest-
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.6: Stop listening to him. They are nothing more than just pitiful spectres.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.7: Dangerous, yes, yet they are not that different from the ones you have already defeated.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.8: Your next target is one of his most powerful manifestations : the Ender Dragon.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.9: To reach him, you'll need the twelve Eyes.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.10: He made your task much easier my summoning his Deadly Sins. They should all bear a fragment.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.11: You should also visit the Moon, where undead hide from the light of the sun.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.12: Then tread deep into the caves, into the Otherside, to confront dark and terrifying creatures.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_set.13: Finally you should defeat Gaïa's Gardian, to prove to everyone, yourself included, that you have become much more powerful.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_ask.te: Are you ready to seal him again ?
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_yes_se: All that journey... to upgrade what you already had.
Forge all these elements into something truly supreme.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter3_no_set: Don't make us wait too long. His followers are waiting for you.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter4_set.1: You've defeated the Ender Dragon and freed its dimension.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter4_set.2: It may be the first one to be truly free. Yet, it has already been destroyed, emptied of all of its life.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter4_set.3: Stop. Please. You do not know what you are doing. It will not end the way of want it to end.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter4_set.4: She is lying to you, only to steal your strength and mines.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter4_set.5: She is making you create the best weapon only to steal it once it's the most powerful one.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter4_set.6: Most of the creatures you've killed were not even my emissaries. They were the gardians of powerful artefacts.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter4_set.7: By killing them, you are directly provoking the wrath of the Gods. I beg you.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter4_ask.te: Seal him now. I swear I will make you regret having hesitated even one second.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter4_yes_se: Now heed my words. For the next two seals, you'll need two mythical swords.
The first one is the Master Sword. Finding it is the easy part, the hard part is making it truly legendary.
You will need to roam into space, explore the different planets of the Solar System and triumph of the many dark and twisted dungeons.
The second one is the Great Sword of Gael. This will be your true test of strength.
This sword is the cumulation of twelve others, each more powerful than the other.
You'll need to enter the Astral Dimension which is controlled by the Titan of Void, to locate more of his followers.
These swords can be crafted in this order you desire. But you'll need to have both of them to continue.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter4_no_set: To hesitate is a proof of your own weakness. A weakness you shouldn't allow to exist.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter_5_6_pas: I have been pondering a lot lately. There is something I want to show you : my past
You can decline... but if you decide to hear it, you will finally understand...
There was a time when I was one of them. A God.
I was the leader of the monsters, the wild creatures, the dangerous ones, the ones no one dared to approach.
They were mocking me, loathing me.
One day a monster killed a human, without my permission.
And she... She used this death to organize a trial. She made a spectacle of me before the other Gods.
What you don't know, is the reason she hates me.
There was this women, a women she loved, a women I unknowingly turned into a monster.
When she learned about it... she killed the women she once loved of her own hands and hated me for that.
They banished me, sealed me. Far, far away from everything, to the top of the world, where nothing could ever reach me.
And then I heard HIS voice, the voice of a young men. He told me that they were fakes, not gods.
At least, he is telling the truth this time. He was banished, that is true.
But don't let yourself be moved by his sad story. He never was a god, because he always was a liar.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter_5_6_sea: You have done everything I asked you. I am impressed.
Seal him and they will be only one seal left. After that, we'll finally finish this journey.
His hold over the worlds is slowly crumbling. He no longer has any followers. It's almost over.
Prepare yourself, the end is nigh.
Wait, this will not be enough, you will need something more powerful.
His power are getting stronger by the minute. The more of his forms you kill, the more his power gather into a single being : him
I will grant you the Sword of Light, with it, fuse the Master Sword and the Great Sword of Gael.
By doing that, you will forge Excalibur, Sword of Light. Then craft the Royal Sword, the most powerful weapon to exist in the world.
When done, come back... I will free him, as long as he is sealed, he is invulnerable to any of our attacks.
A magnificent idea... Really... Yet, I have an even better one.
Take this, with this essence you will be able to forge the Sword of the Demon King
With it, craft the Sword of Nightmares, break the seals that imprison me and help me free myself.
If you help me, I swear I will come back amongst the Gods to calm my monsters.
Do not listen to him. He only wants one thing : to be free and kill you afterwards.
Fool. Truly foolish. No matter, once I am free, this world will become mine !
What a terrible idea. But... I respect your choice and leave it to Fate.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter_7_prolo: You are here. After all this journey, you really are here...
I have built this adventure specifically for you. I do hope you had fun.
The time has come to end it all and free these souls trapped in a neverending conflict.
No matter the path you chose, you will always be able to experience the other later.
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter_7_light: [She looks at the sword] This... this is a wonder. With it, we will be free from this torment.
I must confess. What he told you... it wasn't entirely false.
I did transform the women I loved into a monster. But I don't think he understood what he did.
He has no feelings. No anger, no joy, or even hatred. He does not lie when he says we want to do good.
He does not see the evil he is doing. This is what makes him dangerous.
It is time... I am proud of you. Good luck.
You've came all this way and managed to survive. You played well, and thanks to you, I regained all of my powers !
Even if it isn't really useful to me.
But it always ends like this. I play with you... and then I cast you aside.
[Laughing] The man above will always grant me rebirth ! Every time someone will need to be entertained...
I will be here ! Even if it means I must die, as long as I am alive... As long as I can experiment...
worldscolliding.dialogue.chapter_7_dark_: What you are going to do is a grave mistake. You will bring even more chaos than necessary. But it is your fate and your fate alone.
Finally. Someone smart enough to listen to me.
Defeat my last incarnation, and I will be free. I will bring you there, defeat me please.
You stuck to your words. I will do the same.
I know you let yourself be manipulated. But it is all over now. I will leave this place.
I will try to rise... To reach for the voice that guided me. I think it is my God.
You have done it ! Even though it was not the way I intended... but he now is banished.
This has been my mission in this world : guide you to the end and banish him.
This mission being accomplished, I no longer have any reason to stay here.
I will leave for another world. Because of my sins, I am stuck in an endless cycle.
Thank you, for everything you have done... I mean it.
worldscolliding.dialogue.new_game_plus_c: Congratulations on finishing this modpack ! You can battle once again the Awakened Scourge !
But you will need to choose once again : Light Essence or Dark Essence ?
